gloss: formal report; official reply to an inquiry

definitions.gloss: formal report; official reply to an inquiry
definitions.explanation: A formal report or recommendation that an advisory body returns in response to a {諮問|しもん} (official inquiry), especially in government or institutional settings.

examples.japanese: {審議会|しんぎかい}が{答申|とうしん}を{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The council issued a formal report.

examples.japanese: {大臣|だいじん}は{答申|とうしん}の{内容|ないよう}を{尊重|そんちょう}すると{述|の}べた。
examples.english: The minister said he would respect the content of the report.

examples.japanese: {諮問|しもん}を{受|う}けた{委員会|いいんかい}は、{半年|はんとし}の{議論|ぎろん}を{経|へ}て{答申|とうしん}をまとめた。
examples.english: The committee that had received the inquiry compiled its report after half a year of discussion.

notes:
Used in governmental and institutional settings. The typical process is: an authority {諮問|しもん}s (consults) an advisory body, which then produces a {答申|とうしん} (formal report) in reply.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {答申|とうしん}を{出|だ}す: to issue a report
- {答申|とうしん}を{受|う}ける: to receive a report
- {答申|とうしん}{案|あん}: a draft report

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {諮問|しもん}: official inquiry — the consultation that a {答申|とうしん} responds to
- {報告|ほうこく}{書|しょ}: report — a general written report, not tied to a formal inquiry
